# Run the code 

Use the window below to run code that will be computed here thanks to a [Quarto extension](https://quarto.org/docs/extensions/) called [webr](https://quarto-webr.thecoatlessprofessor.com/).

You can install a package using the `webr::install()` function.

Below you can find a familiar exercise from the Maps session:

```{webr-r}
webr::install("tidyverse")

library(tidyverse)

ggplot(data = diamonds, aes(x=carat,y=price,color=cut))+
  geom_point()

```
